mainEntity.name: How do I book a minicab from West Kensington W14 to Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can book online through our secure platform, call our team, or complete a quick reservation in minutes. All West Kensington W14 bookings receive instant confirmation with driver details and a guaranteed fixed price.

mainEntity.name: How far is West Kensington W14 from Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: West Kensington W14 is approximately 10 miles (16 km) from Heathrow Airport, primarily via the A4 and M4 corridor. Depending on traffic, journey times range from 25 to 45 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What is the minicab fare from West Kensington W14 to Heathrow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our West Kensington W14 to Heathrow saloon fare starts from £47 with a fully fixed price. The airport pickup fare is slightly higher at £52 to include terminal waiting and parking allowances.

mainEntity.name: Is Meet and Greet available at Heathrow for West Kensington W14 passengers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our complimentary Meet & Greet service is available at all four Heathrow terminals. Your chauffeur waits in the arrivals hall with a personalised name board and assists with luggage before your transfer to West Kensington W14.

mainEntity.name: Is LTR Minicab available 24 hours a day from West Kensington W14?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our West Kensington W14 minicab service operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week including public holidays, with no out-of-hours surcharges applied to any booking.

mainEntity.name: Is LTR Minicab an affordable Heathrow transfer from West Kensington W14?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. LTR Minicab offers affordable and competitive Heathrow transfer fares from West Kensington W14 starting from just £47 for a Saloon. All prices are fixed at the time of booking with no surge pricing or hidden fees.

mainEntity.name: Which airports can I travel to from West Kensington W14?

acceptedAnswer.text: We operate direct transfers from West Kensington W14 to Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, London City, and Southend Airport with fixed fares and professional licensed chauffeurs.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer group transfers from West Kensington W14?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We provide MPV 5, MPV 6, MPV 7, and MPV 8 vehicles for families and groups travelling from West Kensington W14 to airports, hotels, and UK destinations.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover event transfers to and from Olympia London in W14?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We regularly provide minicab transfers to and from Olympia London for exhibitions, trade shows, conferences, and consumer events, with vehicles available for individuals, groups, and exhibitors with equipment.

mainEntity.name: Is the West Kensington W14 service available on weekends and bank holidays?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our West Kensington W14 minicab service runs every day of the year including weekends and all UK bank holidays at no additional cost.
